scene.secondaryElements: Swirling incense haze in the sanctuary; soft lamplight on the stone walls; the hem of the radiance's train pouring across the floor and filling the hall
scene.mood: Awed, reverent and grieving, with quiet stillness and a sense of profound human smallness before glory
scene.timeOfDay: Single unchanging interior hour with soft lamplight and radiance-lit stone
scene.composition: Low viewpoint from the temple floor looking up toward the high sanctuary; Isaiah small in the lower foreground, the veiled radiance dominating the upper frame
